pages.title: Winged Torch
pages.text: $(o)The spellcaster is able reach into the astral plane and summon a winged torch. The torch will remain under your charge until you release it or it perishes.

pages.title: Winged Torch Recipe
pages.text: Allows the spellcaster to summon a winged torch. Lasts indefinitely, until killed or dispelled.$(br)Brightness = 15$(br)Duration = infinite
